name: Lebanese Roastery & Market
tagline:
A little discovery.
A lot to savor.
about: Discover nuts, coffee, spices, halal sweets and pantry favorites at Brookfield Plaza in Springfield. Browse the shelves for something familiar or try something new — customers love the selection, generous samples and warm welcome.
locationNote: Brookfield Plaza · Nuts, coffee & specialty groceries

themeCopy.services:

reviews.author: Abena Adjei
reviews.text: This market is amazing! They have a great selection of halal candy, spices, and pantry items.

reviews.author: Marisa P
reviews.text: I'm so happy I found this place! I visited for the first time today and was warmly welcomed with fresh coffee and had the chance to taste several delicious items.

reviews.author: Jeem Chowdhury
reviews.text: The shopkeepers are very friendly and even let you try the sample before you buy it. Its is a small shop but with quality products.
